entry.title: Improved Polymath Bounds on Dense Progression-Free Sets in $\mathbb{F}_p^n$ and Formalization in Lean 4
entry.summary:
We establish a sharper upper bound of $(c p)^{n}$ with $c < 0.841$ for subsets of $\mathbb{F}_p^n$ lacking three-term arithmetic progressions via slice-rank polynomial spectral stability. The core combinatorial reduction and spectral lemma have been fully mechanized in Lean 4 against Mathlib, uncovering a tighter constant than the classical Ellenberg-Gijswijt bound in low characteristic.

Source: arXiv Mathematics (math.NT) · Tags: #number-theory #combinatorics #formal-proofs
